Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 여정이 얼마 남지 않아, 다나가 <color=#F7BE45>쿠나마타</color>를 제안해왔다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: As the Journey neared its end, Dana suggested we perform a <color=#F7BE45>kunamata</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 旅も終わりに近づき、ダーナは<color=#F7BE45>クナマタ</color>を提案してきた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 旅程所剩无几，达娜提议进行<color=#F7BE45>库纳马塔</color>。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 旅程所剩無幾，達娜提議進行<color=#F7BE45>庫納馬塔</color>。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Le périple touche à sa fin, Dana a proposé un <color=#F7BE45>kunamata</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Da die Reise bald zu Ende war, schlug Dana ein <color=#F7BE45>Kunamata</color> vor.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Faltaba poco para el final de la Travesía, y Dana sugirió hacer un <color=#F7BE45>kunamata</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A jornada está quase no fim, então Dana sugeriu fazermos um <color=#F7BE45>kunamata</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: การเดินทางใกล้จะสิ้นสุดลงแล้ว ดาน่าจึงเสนอให้เราทำ <color=#F7BE45>คุนามะตะ</color>
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Perjalanan hampir berakhir, dan Dana mengusulkan <color=#F7BE45>kunamata</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Chuyến hành trình sắp kết thúc, Dana đã đề xuất <color=#F7BE45>Kunamata</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: यात्रा समाप्त होने वाली थी, इसलिए डाना ने <color=#F7BE45>कुनामाटा</color> का प्रस्ताव रखा।
